description: Chereeka Garner recalls being a high school senior in Orlando, Florida, on September 11, 2001, when her school was preparing to take the senior class photograph. After helping clean up following the photograph, she waited in the courtyard and became confused when the usual school bell did not ring. She walked to class and found students watching television; her history teacher told the class that a plane had hit the World Trade Center. Garner describes watching repeated news coverage, finding the school unusually quiet, and calling her father, who was working at the time. She recalls seeing a long line of parents signing students out, then staying at school until the end of the day before understanding the event’s magnitude at home. The interview was recorded at John C. Hitt Library for the Night Tales Project on September 11, 2026. This interview is part of the UCF Remembers 9/11 collection.

I normally did not have a first period, but because of our senior class photo, I went to school early that day.
